sloka: इति भूतानि सर्वाणि गणशः पर्यदेवयन् ।वित्रस्तका दीन मुखा रुरुदुः मृग पोतकाः ॥३-५२-४०॥
transliteration: iti bhūtāni sarvāṇi gaṇaśaḥ paryadevayan ।vitrastakā dīna mukhā ruruduḥ mṛga potakāḥ ॥3-52-40॥

translations.english: The young deer full of fear and distress looked again and again with eyes blurred with tears at the direction in which Sita went. And wept.
